title.narrative: Promoting CSOs as partners in building resilient social services

description.narrative: This Action will address the geographical focus of the call on areas outside the capital of Chisinau by re-designing the community-based social services delivered by CSOs or PAs in rural communities. One of the key prioritiy will also be the involvement of communities from 7 districts (Briceni, Ocnita, Floresti, Soldanesti, Rezina, Nisporeni, Hincesti) where there are no previous initiatives implemented by CSOs on social services development and delivery in partnership with public LPAs
